page.layout: One page of text, single column of verse and prose; ornamental rule and title block in the upper-middle; no marginal notes on the printed page (faint show-through from the other side at the right is ignored). Page number top left, running head top centre.

main_text.head: DEPLORATIO INOBITVM TRISTISSIMVM ILLVSTRISsimi Principis Condæi, Henrici Borbonij veneno sublati.
main_text.p: ORBONICÆ cecidit gentis fortißimus Heros, Dolis petitus Colchicis: Quem non perpetuis potuerunt perdere bellis, Iræ potentes Principum: Quem non aduersæ trepidum videre phalanges, Periculisque territum: Quem nulla hostilis vicit victoria, fortem Per damna quæuis crescere. Imbelles animas, ignauáque pectora, Francûm Pudenda carcinomata, Vos superis perdat iaculatus ab arcibus ignes Deus rubente dextera.

page.notes: The initial B is a large woodcut letter, joined in the transcription to the first word "ORBONICÆ" as printed with small capitals. Some words in the verse are set in italic; the Greek-style accent marks are not present. The running head and page number are printed at the head of the page.
